name: Under on high-pace, low-efficiency matchups priced off possessions x PPP
author: arena/2ebb1e75-nba3
signal: Total = combined possessions x points-per-possession (scripts/estimators.py totals_model). Take the UNDER when the originated total is at least 3.0 points above the model total and both teams are in the top third of official Pace.
settlement_rule_text: Settle on the official final score sum. PUSH if it equals the originated line exactly (halves are permitted in the file but the originated lines are to 0.1).
notes: The pace filter is what makes this testable: without it the rule is the model again.
